correctness.rationale: The proof checks the exact Fisher local degree-zero/two matching rule, bijectivity, component-preserving correspondence of matching symmetric differences with base cycle components, complete (a,x) parity parametrization of all prism even subgraphs, and both cases of the simple-cycle criterion. These imply the exact join graph and all distance numbers for every n>=3. Independent exact checking of primal cycle-space structure for n=3..9 and direct matching-pair adjacency for n=3..7 corroborates all asserted finite consequences; the all-n claim rests on the proof.

value.rationale: The exact adjacency classification for an infinite family with exponentially many perfect matchings reveals a sharp and uniform diameter-two global mobility phenomenon. The two-layer circular-interval Cayley decomposition and exact degree 2^n+n(n-1) are nontrivial structural refinements, not a renamed count or one isolated small-graph computation. This result supports explicit reconfiguration routing and sampling-state geometry, without claiming mixing bounds or a general cubic-graph theorem.
